preamble.summary: Isaiah 11 is the SHOOT-FROM-JESSE Messianic prophecy — the seven-fold Spirit (vv. 1–3), the just-judgment of the Messianic-king (vv. 3–5), and the peaceable-kingdom (vv. 6–9: 'wolf shall dwell with the lamb'). Verse 10 is cited at Romans 15:12 — the fourth and-final text in Paul's Gentile-inclusion catena. The seven-fold spirit (vv. 2) provides the foundation for the Christian-tradition of 'seven gifts of the Spirit.'
preamble.notable_variants: 11:1 SHOOT-FROM-JESSE Messianic-imagery; 11:2 SEVEN-FOLD SPIRIT (LXX adds 'piety' = seven gifts); 11:6–9 PEACEABLE-KINGDOM imagery; 11:10 → Romans 15:12 verbatim-LXX Gentile-inclusion citation.
preamble.structural_notes: MT Isaiah 11 = LXX Isaiah 11. 16 verses. THE MESSIANIC-PROPHECY chapter.

variant_notes: 'There shall come forth a shoot from the stump of Jesse, and a branch from his roots shall bear fruit' tracks MT. SHOOT-FROM-STUMP. The 'stump' (gez'a) is the Davidic-line-cut-down — yet a SHOOT (choter) and BRANCH (netzer) emerge. The Hebrew NETZER may be the source of NAZARENE — Matthew 2:23 ('he shall be called a Nazarene') possibly draws on this verse's-vocabulary. Romans 15:12 cites v. 10 explicitly.

verses.mt_reading: וְנָחָה עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהוָה רוּחַ חָכְמָה וּבִינָה רוּחַ עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה רוּחַ דַּעַת וְיִרְאַת יְהוָה
verses.lxx_reading: καὶ ἀναπαύσεται ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ συνέσεως πνεῦμα βουλῆς καὶ ἰσχύος πνεῦμα γνώσεως καὶ εὐσεβείας
verses.mt_rendering: And the Spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the LORD
verses.variant_rendering: And the Spirit of God shall rest upon him: the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and piety
variant_notes: SEVEN-FOLD SPIRIT — CHRISTIAN TRADITION OF 'SEVEN GIFTS.' The MT-Hebrew lists six attributes paired with the umbrella-Spirit-of-the-LORD = seven total. The LXX's-distinctive substitution of EUSEBEIA ('piety, godliness') for-the-second-'fear-of-the-LORD' (instead-of repeating it) became the basis-for-the-Latin-tradition's seven-gifts-of-the-Holy-Spirit (sapientia/wisdom, intellectus/understanding, consilium/counsel, fortitudo/might, scientia/knowledge, pietas/piety, timor Domini/fear-of-the-Lord).

Christian-confirmation rites traditionally-list these seven-gifts. Revelation 1:4, 3:1, 4:5, 5:6 ('seven spirits of God') extend the seven-fold-Spirit tradition. The seven-fold Spirit-rests-on-the-Messianic-shoot, identifying-Christ as the supreme-Spirit-bearer.

ANOINTING-THEOLOGY. The Spirit-rests-on-the-shoot anticipates Jesus' baptism (Matt 3:16, 'the Spirit of God descended like a dove') and Acts 10:38 ('how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power').

'And his delight shall be in the fear of the LORD. He shall not judge by what his eyes see, or decide disputes by what his ears hear' tracks MT. NOT-JUDGE-BY-EYES-AND-EARS — the Messianic-king's-judgment transcends-superficial-evidence. John 7:24 ('judge with right judgment, not by appearances') Christologically extends.

'But with righteousness he shall judge the poor, and decide with equity for the meek of the earth; and he shall strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he shall kill the wicked' tracks MT. ROD-OF-HIS-MOUTH / BREATH-OF-HIS-LIPS — Messianic-king-judges-by-word. 2 Thess 2:8 ('the Lord Jesus will slay him with the breath of his mouth,' tō pneumati tou stomatos autou) directly-cites-this verse for-the-Antichrist's-overthrow. Revelation 1:16, 19:15, 19:21 ('sharp two-edged sword from his mouth') extend.

'Righteousness shall be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his loins' tracks MT. RIGHTEOUSNESS-AS-BELT. Ephesians 6:14 ('having fastened on the belt of truth … the breastplate of righteousness') extends to-Christian-armor.

'The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the young goat, and the calf and the lion and the fattened calf together; and a little child shall lead them' tracks MT. WOLF-AND-LAMB. THE PEACEABLE-KINGDOM. Edward Hicks' 19th-century painting tradition. Eden-restored / new-creation imagery. Christologically-fulfilled in-eschatological-creation (Romans 8:19–22, Revelation 21–22).
'The cow and the bear shall graze; their young shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox' tracks MT.

'The nursing child shall play over the hole of the cobra, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder's den' tracks MT. CHILD-AND-COBRA — fearless. The Genesis-3:15 serpent-and-seed enmity Christologically-resolved in-the-peaceable-kingdom.

'They shall not hurt or destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea' tracks MT. EARTH-FULL-OF-KNOWLEDGE-OF-LORD. Habakkuk 2:14's 'the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD' parallels. The eschatological-universal-divine-knowledge.

verses.mt_reading: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שֹׁרֶשׁ יִשַׁי אֲשֶׁר עֹמֵד לְנֵס עַמִּים אֵלָיו גּוֹיִם יִדְרֹשׁוּ וְהָיְתָה מְנֻחָתוֹ כָּבוֹד
verses.lxx_reading: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ιεσσαι καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἀνάπαυσις αὐτοῦ τιμή
verses.mt_rendering: In that day the root of Jesse, who shall stand as a signal for the peoples — of him shall the nations inquire, and his resting place shall be glorious
verses.variant_rendering: In that day there shall be the root of Jesse, even he who arises to rule the nations; in him shall the Gentiles hope, and his rest shall be honor
variant_notes: ROMANS 15:12 CITATION — GENTILE-INCLUSION CATENA FINAL TEXT. Paul cites this verse VERBATIM-FROM-LXX at Romans 15:12, the FOURTH and-final-text in his Gentile-inclusion catena (15:9–12): 'And again Isaiah says: THE ROOT OF JESSE WILL COME, EVEN HE WHO ARISES TO RULE THE GENTILES; IN HIM WILL THE GENTILES HOPE (estai hē rhiza tou Iessai, kai ho anistamenos archein ethnōn; ep' autō ethnē elpiousin).' Paul's text-matches-the-LXX exactly.

GENTILES-HOPE-IN-MESSIAH. The LXX's-rendering 'in him will the Gentiles hope' (where MT has 'of him will the nations inquire') gives the Christological-payoff: Gentiles-as-hopers-in-Christ. The verse anchors-Paul's-argument that-Gentile-inclusion is-prophetically-promised, not-a-Pauline-innovation.

ROOT-OF-JESSE / ROOT-OF-DAVID. Revelation 5:5 ('the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered'), 22:16 ('I am the root and the descendant of David') Christologically-extends. Christ as both-the-source AND descendant of-David.

'In that day the Lord will extend his hand yet a second time to recover the remnant that remains of his people, from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the coastlands of the sea' tracks MT. SECOND-RECOVERY of-the-remnant — eschatological-gathering. Acts 15:16 (James-citing Amos 9:11) parallels.

'He will raise a signal for the nations and will assemble the banished of Israel, and gather the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth' tracks MT. FROM-THE-FOUR-CORNERS gathering. Matt 24:31 (angels gathering elect from-four-winds) extends.

'The jealousy of Ephraim shall depart, and those who harass Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not be jealous of Judah, and Judah shall not harass Ephraim' tracks MT. END-OF-CIVIL-DIVISION. Ezekiel 37:15–22 (two-sticks-becoming-one) parallels.

'But they shall swoop down on the shoulder of the Philistines in the west, and together they shall plunder the people of the east. They shall put out their hand against Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites shall obey them' tracks MT.

'And the LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Sea of Egypt, and will wave his hand over the River with his scorching breath, and strike it into seven channels, and he will lead people across in sandals' tracks MT. ANTI-TYPE-OF-EXODUS — second-Exodus-imagery.

'And there will be a highway from Assyria for the remnant that remains of his people, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt' tracks MT. HIGHWAY-FROM-ASSYRIA — return-from-exile imagery. Isaiah 35:8, 40:3's 'highway-of-the-LORD' extends. Mark 1:3 (John-the-Baptist's-citation) Christologically-fulfills.
